nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Frontend-specific developer guidelines covering state management via the useFocusGroup hook, client component conventions, Tailwind CSS v4 styling, and requirements for PDF and DOCX report export. Supplements the root-level AGENTS.md with frontend-only rules.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Minimal pointer document that delegates all frontend Claude Code instructions to the root AGENTS.md via an @-reference directive.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive frontend getting-started guide covering the Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 stack, directory structure, SSE-based real-time streaming architecture with the FastAPI backend, and setup/run instructions.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package manifest for the Next.js 16 frontend, declaring runtime dependencies (next, react, react-dom, jspdf, docx) and devDependencies (tailwindcss v4, typescript, eslint, type packages) with dev/build/lint/start scripts.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the Next.js frontend enabling strict mode, ESNext module output with bundler resolution, JSX react-jsx transform, incremental compilation, and an @/* path alias mapping to the frontend root.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses moduleResolution: bundler (Next.js 13+ recommended setting) and the Next.js TypeScript plugin for enhanced IDE support. The @/* path alias enables clean absolute imports throughout the frontend.
